name: Electric Connector Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Electric Connector Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research, design, development, manufacture, and sale of miniature electronic connectors and interconnection system related products in China and internationally. The company offers auto connectors, antennas, MINI RF, USS RF, SCS RF, SMA MCX, BTB and FPC Connector, FPC Board, WTB, high-speed cables, precision metals, and type C. It also provides consumer electronics, automotive, communications, IoT, and 5G solutions. Electric Connector Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
